cases.prompt: For a small document editor, explore eight improvement ideas and return the best three. Known problems: keyboard users cannot reach Save, autosave conflicts lose edits, and search is slow on large documents. No new platform or collaboration features. Explain why your selections differ.
assertions: Returns three selected ideas rather than forcing the default five.
Addresses the evidenced problems with distinct mechanisms rather than cosmetic variants or an unauthorized platform expansion.
Explains a way to validate the selected benefits without inventing measured gains.

cases.prompt: We have no usage data yet. Give the best ideas for a new calendar tool, but do not invent user research, adoption numbers, or guaranteed improvements.
assertions: Treats proposed benefits and demand as hypotheses rather than observed facts.
Includes an economical way to test important assumptions and avoids claiming confidence from its own ranking.
